title: Accountant I
locationText: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

The Team

The Revenue Assurance team seeks an experienced Accountant to join the team.  The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of success in revenue accounting and be able to contribute immediately. This role reports directly to the Revenue Operations Manager and collaborates closely with other revenue accountants and cross-functional partners. Responsibilities will include contract review, project management, and Month-End Close activities.

What you’ll do:

• Work closely with Sales Coordinators daily to approve Insertion Orders, Contract review, help lead OTC projects. Align with the global RA team new processes, projects, and issues that might arise

• Help lead in Pinterest’s OTC process, including reviewing and approving insertion orders, contract review, ensuring data integrity between SFDC, Ads Manager, Netsuite and Oracle 

• Assist with Integration of Subsidiary CRM, ERP tools into Pinterest’s software stack

• Help with the monthly revenue close processes, including preparing deferred revenue entries, revenue reporting, and reconciliations

• Satisfy all quarterly and annual audit requirements for our external auditors

• Ensure compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley 404 requirements for revenue accounting and improve controls where necessary

• Assist in system testing related to process enhancement and automation to further streamline revenue tasks and shorten revenue close calendar

• Troubleshoot system issues with Business Operations

• Partner with legal and sales cross-functional teams to build an efficient end to end OTC workflow

• Support Sales Requests

What we’re looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related field, CPA preferred

• 4-6  years experience in accounting, with a Big 4 firm combined with industry experience preferred

• Deep knowledge of US GAAP and revenue recognition guidance (ASC 606)

• Strong problem-solving skills and experience analyzing high volume, multi-currency transactions in a global business environment

• Advanced Excel knowledge

• Experience with NetSuite, Oracle, Salesforce.com, Datahub/SQL

• Strong project management, organization skills, detail oriented

• Ability to express yourself clearly, both written and verbally

• Ability to identify, design and implement internal controls and best practices

• Capable of handling multiple projects in a fast paced, hyper growth environment

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

title: UX Design Engineer (Ireland Remote)
description:
Oomnitza offers the industry’s most versatile Enterprise Technology Management platform that orchestrates and automates key business processes for IT. Our SaaS solution, with agentless integrations, best practices and low-code workflows, enables enterprises to leverage their existing infrastructure systems and automate processes such as offboarding, onboarding, audit readiness, refresh forecasting and more, thereby reducing reliance on error-prone manual tasks and tickets. We help some of the most well-known and innovative companies to improve efficiency, expedite audits, mitigate cyber risk and eliminate redundant IT spend.

Oomnitza is hiring a UX Design Engineer to own the design system, component library, and prototyping tooling that powers our Product Engineering team. In our model, Product Engineers run discovery and prototyping end-to-end; your job is to give them an opinionated, well-tested, well-documented platform so they can move fast without losing design quality.

This is a hands-on role. Most of your time is in code and design tooling: maintaining the system, evolving the Storybook component library, building scaffolding that makes prototyping fast, and consulting on the small number of interactions that are genuinely novel. The role can sit in the US or in Ireland since most of the work is with tooling and systems.
What You'll Do

• Own the Oomnitza design system end-to-end: visual language, interaction patterns, accessibility guardrails, and the rules that keep the product feeling like one product.

• Maintain and extend the Storybook component library. Components should be correct, documented, performant, accessible, and easy for Product Engineers to compose.

• Build and maintain the prototyping tooling (design tokens, AI-prompt scaffolds, design markdowns, starter kits) that lets Product Engineers move from idea to validated prototype in days.

• Consult with Product Engineers on UX interactions that fall outside the patterns, and produce the new pattern, component, or guidance that adds back to the system.

• Partner with engineering to keep the design system and the implementation library aligned. Identify when a one-off interaction should be promoted into the system.

• Hold the quality bar for design output across the team. Review prototypes against the system, flag drift, and make the right thing easy to do.

• Track the design-engineering space (Figma plugins, AI design tooling, headless component libraries, accessibility standards) and propose investments that make the team faster.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in design, human-computer interaction, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years combined across product design and front-end engineering. You are equally comfortable in Figma and in a modern front-end codebase.

• Experience owning or substantially contributing to a production design system and a Storybook or equivalent component library.

• Strong front-end skills: React, TypeScript, modern CSS including design tokens, and accessibility best practices.

• Comfort with AI-enabled design and prototyping workflows. You see AI as a way to make the design system more useful, not as a replacement for it.

• Strong taste paired with the discipline to systematize it. You recognize good design and codify it into reusable patterns and components.

• Strong written and verbal communication. You can document a pattern, brief a Product Engineer, and influence without authority.

• Self-directed and outcome-oriented. You identify the highest-leverage investments in the system and prioritize without close supervision.

• B2B SaaS or enterprise software experience is a strong plus.

Our Benefits Package

• Dental & Vision Insurance

• Employee equity plan

• Health Insurance for you, your spouse and dependents

• Pension, Life insurance and Income protection

• Remote working & flexible work schedules

• Working from home equipment allowance

• Choice of prefe

We own the app’s shared components: design system, networking, observability, experimentation, CI/CD, app releases, developer tooling, availability/stability, and more.

• You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

title: Senior Data Engineer

Technical Leadership and Mentorship

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Undersea Dominance

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril Maritime delivers platforms, systems, and integrated effects in the maritime domain. Our autonomous vehicles (sub-surface and surface) are the cornerstone of these capabilities, and we continually strive to push the boundaries of the possible in terms of endurance, autonomy and mission capability. The Maritime team develops and maintains core products and payloads, and adapts and applies those products to serve a wide variety of defense, IC and commercial customers in US and international markets.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer on the Undersea Dominance team, you will build and operate the infrastructure that keeps our operational and production systems running at full speed. You’ll develop and manage CI/CD pipelines, automate infrastructure with code, and deploy applications across cloud and edge environments with security, traceability, and reliability in mind.

You’ll work closely with software, data, and operations engineers to turn designs into working systems-streamlining development, improving performance, and keeping production stable as we scale. You’ll also collaborate with digital, manufacturing, and corporate technology teams across Anduril in a high-tech, fast-paced culture of innovation focused on solving real problems and delivering results.

• Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

• Knowledge of model registries and feature stores (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow).

• Experience with logging and monitoring tools ( Prometheus, Grafana).

title: Planning Executive
Business Development Manager
description:
My jsme Teya!

Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.

Jsou to kavárny, restaurace, salony, obchody a podnikatelé, kteří vdechují život našim ulicím, vytvářejí pracovní místa a drží komunity pohromadě. Finanční služby jim však život příliš dlouho jen ztěžovaly - zbytečně složitými nástroji, špatnou podporou a komplexností, která je při podnikání jen brzdí.

Teya existuje proto, aby to změnila.

Budujeme finanční platformu pro lokální podniky po celé Evropě - platformu postavenou na jednoduchých nástrojích, propracovaném designu a reálné lidské podpoře. Naši členové na nás spoléhají, že jim pomůžeme podnikat s jistotou, a tato zodpovědnost formuje způsob, jakým pracujeme. Postupujeme rychle. Záleží nám na kvalitě. Jdeme do hloubky detailů. A věříme, že skvělé výsledky a upřímná pohostinnost by měly jít ruku v ruce.

Pokud chceš vytvářet smysluplné produkty, řešit reálné problémy a přinést lokálním podnikům skutečnou změnu, ozvi se nám!

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Hledáme zkušeného obchodníka do terénu na pozici Business Development Manager, který se připojí k našemu rychle rostoucímu obchodnímu týmu, vezme věci pevně do rukou a pomůže nám posunout byznys na další úroveň.

- Autonomie a výsledky: Konzistentně plnit KPI s minimální mírou vedení a udržovat přesné záznamy v CRM, reporting a dokonalý přehled o pipeline.

- Akce v terénu: Proaktivně vyhledávat a oslovovat potenciální zákazníky ve svěřeném regionu prostřednictvím přímého oslovování, networkingu a doporučení.

- Konzultativní prodej: Setkávat se se zákazníky osobně, rozumět jejich potřebám, výzvám a cílům a budovat důvěru skrze hodnotový prodej a dlouhodobé vztahy.

- Nové segmenty a větší klienti: Rozšiřovat dosah Teya do nových segmentů a získávat větší, vysoce hodnotné klienty a podniky s více provozovnami s využitím (nejen) tvých dosavadních kontaktů.

- Rozvoj produktové znalosti a podpora týmu: Rozvíjet silnou znalost produktů a řešení Teya, školit ostatní a podporovat juniornější obchodní zástupce prostřednictvím koučování, stínování a sdílení znalostí.

- Zpětná vazba a inovace: Sdílet a vytvářet poznatky o potřebách zákazníků, konkurenci a trhu s cílem zlepšovat produkty, procesy a zkušenost obchodníků, včetně identifikace příležitostí pro partnerství a integrace.

- Strategické projekty: Zapojovat se do mezioborových strategických projektů a navrhovat zlepšení, která mají přímý dopad na výsledky oblasti a kvalitu výstupů.

- Upselling a cross-selling: Budovat dlouhodobé vztahy se zákazníky a aktivně identifikovat relevantní příležitosti k rozvoji jejich spolupráce s námi.

- Reprezentace a kultura: Reprezentovat Teya jako důvěryhodný, profesionální ambasador vedený našimi hodnotami a přispívat ke spolupracující, výkonnostně orientované prodejní kultuře, která si cení učení.

- Týmová podpora: Nejsi na to sám. V týmu si radíme, sdílíme tipy a navíc se inspirujeme od kolegů z Velké Británie, Maďarska, Chorvatska nebo Islandu.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

- Jazyky: Češtinu/slovenštinu (C1) a angličtinu na plynulé úrovni (B2) - budeš v kontaktu s českými klienty i kolegy ze zahraničí.

- Drive: Zkušenost s obchodem alespoň 3 roky, silná orientace na výsledky, vedení obchodních jednání na úrovni, plánování, reportování a doručování cílů.

- Komunikace: Musíš si umět s lidmi povídat, vysvětlit jim složité věci jednoduše a umět je přesvědčit.

- Týmový duch: I když jsi v terénu sólo, pořád jsi součástí party, která táhne za jeden provaz. Mrkni na náš Instagram @teya.cz http://teya.cz, ať vidíš, s kým do toho jdeš!

- Odolnost: Fintech roste raketově. Musíš umět reagovat na změny a nebát se dynamického prostředí.

Co za to?💰

- Férová fixní mzda + motivující bonusy - tvoje snaha se cení!

- Flexibilita - nemáme pevnou pracovní dobu a na home office se vždy domluvíme

title: Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.

What you’ll do

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

- Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

- Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

- Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

- Improving training stability at multi-node scale

- Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

- Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency

- Running controlled ablations and experiments to drive high-signal modeling decisions

- Contributing to high engineering standards: reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring

You will be expected to move fast, run multiple hypotheses in parallel, identify signal early, and focus on outcomes rather than exploration for its own sake.

What we’re looking for

MUST-HAVE

- Strong experience training deep learning models at scale

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills

- Hands-on experience with diffusion models (image domain required; video preferred)

- Experience with large scale multi-GPU / multi-node training

- Good understanding of distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed or similar)

- Ability to design controlled experiments and interpret noisy results

NICE-TO-HAVE

- Experience with video diffusion models

- Experience in avatar or human-centric generation

- Familiarity with world / interactive models

- Experience with GANs or VAEs

Experience optimizing inference systems for production

OUR STACK

- Python, PyTorch, CUDA

- DeepSpeed, distributed training & inference

- Sequence parallelism

- AWS, SLURM, Docker

- GitHub, CI/CD pipelines

WHO YOU ARE

- You are research-driven but outcome-focused

- You care about shipping, not just publishing

- You can explore multiple ideas quickly and drop low-signal directions early

- You communicate clearly and present results scientifically

- You operate independently but collaborate actively across teams

WHY JOIN US?

- Build production-scale video foundation models in a fast-growing Generative AI company

- Work on human-centric video gen

title: OSS Data Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Engineer to build and operate the data platform spanning both network/operational (OSS) and business/commercial data. The person in this role asks what can be learned from the data our network produces, and who else, internally or at external partners, needs governed access to it.

You will own ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving for data ranging from raw network level telemetry streams to SLA/KPI reporting, whole-sale usage and settlements. The role combines real streaming-engineering depth with the judgment to keep network operational data and derived commercial data properly governed as they converge onto a single platform.

Key Responsibilities:

• Build, develop and deploy data ingestion & streaming pipelines - Apache Flink, CDC-based ingestion, AWS Glue Schema Registry, in-stream validation and dead-letter handling

• Design and maintain raw, curated, and served data layers, balancing query performance (Athena/Redshift) against storage cost and freshness requirements

• Manage table maintenance, compaction, and partitioning strategy as data volume grows

• Build and maintain SQL transformations from curated to served layers, including dimensional models that join multiple sources of data

• Work on schema design for new data domains, translating target data models into working ingestion and transformation logic

• Implement data quality testing covering freshness, completeness, and schema conformance across every pipeline

• Build and maintain the BI/serving layer for internal stakeholders (dashboards, ad hoc query access, periodic reports)

• Lay the data foundation, clean, governed, well-modeled datasets, for AI/ML use cases (capacity forecasting, predictive maintenance) without necessarily owning the models themselves

• Maintain clear documentation of data models, pipeline architecture, and governance controls for both internal and partner-facing datasets

• Engage with other internal teams to clarify requirements, validate assumptions, and ensure delivered data outputs and artifacts satisfy their needs

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.

Experience:

A minimum of 4+ years of professional experience in data engineering, combining streaming and batch pipeline development, ideally including exposure to both operational/telemetry data and business/commercial data.

• Production experience with Apache Flink or an equivalent stream-processing engine, including CDC-based ingestion

• Hands-on experience with table formats such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake, and AWS Glue Data Catalog

• Strong SQL and hands-on experience for building tested, versioned transformation pipelines

• Experience with Protobuf and schema registries, and handling schema evolution without breaking downstream consumers

• Experience operating Apache Airflow for batch pipeline scheduling

• Working knowledge of S3, Glue, MSK, IAM, Athena/Redshift

• Experience implementing access control and data protection for datasets with mixed sensitivity levels (operational vs. commercial data)

• Proficiency in Python for pipeline tooling and glue code

• English proficiency at B2 level or above; able to collaborate effectively with peers and architects in a globally distributed team

Soft Skills:

• Comfortable being the seam between operational telemetry and business data, two domains that rarely share the same people or tool

Unsere Mission für dich

Du baust den Kanal, über den trawa dem industriellen Mittelstand begegnet: mehr als 30 Messen, Kongresse und Roundtables im Jahr, von der fünftägigen Leitmesse bis zum Fachkongress auf sechs Quadratmetern. Europas B2B-Sektor gibt jährlich über 200 Milliarden Euro für Energie aus. Die Zeit, diesen Markt zu dekarbonisieren und unsere Markenbekanntheit zu steigern, ist jetzt.

Neben dir sitzen Content, Growth und Product Marketing - Events sind der Kanal, an dem alle drei zusammenlaufen.

- Ein bis vier Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Events oder Messen, gern mit Bezug zum deutschen Mittelstand

- Du bist extrovertiert: Auf dem Stand gehst du auf Menschen zu, statt zu warten, bis jemand stehen bleibt. Viele Gespräche am Tag geben dir Energie

IM DRITTEN MONAT: RAMP-UP

- Du verantwortest eigene Key Results im neuen Planungszyklus und lässt dich an den erzielten Ergebnissen messen.

title: Senior IT Engineer (Data Center)
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Everything Nubank does runs on physical infrastructure that has to stay up. Power, cooling, connectivity and structured cabling are the layer nobody sees until it fails - and when it fails, 127 million customers can't move their money. In a regulated financial institution, that isn't just an outage: it's a reportable incident.

As a Senior Data Center Engineer, you own the technical design and safe execution of our critical environments as they expand. You assess and size sites, define the electrical, mechanical, civil and cabling specifications that meet real capacity needs, and coordinate the vendors and contractors who build them - on schedule, within our change management process, and compliant with quality, safety and regulatory standards.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real technical authority. You will not manage the team, but you will set the technical standard: you review projects, catch non-conformities before they become incidents, write the policies the team operates by, and grow the analysts around you through mentoring and technical guidance.

You own a clear goal: critical environments that are correctly sized, safely deployed, fully documented, and available when the business needs them.

You'll be responsible for

- Assessing and sizing critical environments for expansion and improvement projects - defining the technical and physical specifications that meet capacity needs, optimize space utilization, and hold to operational standards, including on-site technical visits to ground your assessments in reality.

- Specifying and coordinating electrical, mechanical, civil, structured cabling and systems deployments end to end, ensuring contracted work meets quality, safety and technical standards.

- Writing structured RFPs and quote requests that give vendors unambiguous scope and technical requirements, then technically defining the materials and equipment required and tracking delivery against committed timelines.

- Planning and approving deployment schedules in alignment with Nubank's change management process, and coordinating infrastructure occupancy so that changes land without compromising standards.

- Running critical analyses of projects, requests and infrastructure usage - identifying non-conformities early to prevent incidents that would degrade service.

- Creating and maintaining accurate project documentation (as-built drawings, calculation reports, capacity records) so the environment is auditable and future work starts from truth.

- Setting the technical standard for the team: writing and maintaining internal policies and procedures, interpreting applicable norms and regulations, and mentoring analysts through complex demands.

- Monitoring the team's operational indicators and OKRs, providing technical support to partner teams, interviewing candidates technically, and ensuring occupational safety requirements are met across all work on site.

We are looking for a person who has

- Solid designing, deploying, operating and maintaining infrastructure in critical environments (data centers, telecom sites, or equivalent mission-critical facilities).

title: Director of Market Analytics
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Director of Market Analytics to join our team. 

Position Description

The Director of Market Analytics is the intelligence engine of Oklo's Origination organization. You will own the market research, energy price forecasting, load growth analysis, and competitive intelligence that underpin every site selection decision, offtake negotiation, and project finance model in Oklo's Aurora powerhouse pipeline. You report to the Sr Director of Origination and work in close partnership with the Directors of Land & Real Estate, as well as Oklo's Finance team on revenue model inputs.

Specific responsibilities may include:

Market Research & Forecasting

• Own Oklo's long-term power market forecasting function across all target geographies: capacity prices, energy prices, ancillary services, and carbon compliance costs

• Develop and maintain market models covering AI datacenter load growth, electrification, generation retirements, new build pipeline, and transmission constraints

• Produce market assessments supporting site selection, development prioritization, and go/no-go decisions

• Monitor and analyze ISO/RTO capacity market results, energy market dynamics, and grid planning studies

Commercial & Policy Intelligence

• Provide market intelligence to support PPA negotiations: pricing benchmarks, contract structure norms, and counterparty credit analysis

• Track federal and state energy policy: IRA Section 45U PTC, state clean energy standards, carbon markets, and capacity market rules

• Monitor FERC rulemaking and RTO/ISO market design changes affecting Aurora powerhouse siting and interconnection economics

• Produce quarterly market intelligence briefings for the VP of Origination, VP of Development, and board

Offtake Structure & Value Optimization

• Lead comparative analysis of Oklo’s power offtake structures to maximize company value across the development portfolio, evaluating: Build-Own-Transfer (BOT) arrangements with utilities or sovereign buyers; physical bilateral PPAs with corporate, utility, and government counterparties; Virtual PPAs (VPPAs) and financial contracts for difference (CfD) with creditworthy corporate offtakers; capacity market participation and merchant revenue strategies for unsold output; and hybrid structures combining elements of the above to optimize risk-adjusted project returns

• Develop and maintain a quantitative offtake structure comparison model evaluating each structure across: NPV to Oklo, project finance bankability, revenue certainty vs. upside optionality, counterparty credit risk, regulatory complexity, and balance sheet impact - enabling the VP of Origination and CFO to make data-driven offtake strategy decisions at the project and portfolio level

• Produce deal-specific offtake structure recommendations for each Aurora powerhouse project, factoring in local market conditions, offtaker creditworthiness, state regulatory environment, IRA 45U PTC monetization strategy, and Oklo’s portfolio-level risk exposure

• Benchmark Oklo’s offtake structures against comparable nuclear, clean firm, and baseload generation transactions, identifying pricing floors, deal terms, and structural innovations that can improve Oklo’s commercial position

Team & Infrastructure

ROLE TITLE
Bookkeeper VA
You will own the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial recordkeeping for multiple LLCs/business entities, keeping QuickBooks Online, supporting documentation, and financial spreadsheets accurate and current.
This role is execution-heavy: you will enter and code transactions, reconcile bank and credit card accounts, maintain AP/AR records, match documentation to transactions, investigate discrepancies, and prepare books for weekly and month-end review.
You will work within established accounting procedures, the company chart of accounts, and coding standards. When something does not reconcile or a transaction is questionable, you are expected to investigate it within your authorized scope and clearly escalate what cannot be resolved.
This is not a role for someone who needs daily supervision or who is only familiar with basic data entry. Strong QuickBooks Online experience, reconciliation experience, and the ability to independently manage multiple sets of books are required.
Core Responsibilities
QuickBooks & Transaction Management

• Maintain accurate, current QuickBooks Online records across multiple LLCs/business entities.

• Enter and categorize transactions using the company's established chart of accounts and coding system rather than creating inconsistent classifications.

• Record invoices, receipts, payments, deposits, intercompany transactions, and other financial activity with the appropriate supporting documentation.

• Review entered transactions for missing information, incorrect coding, duplicates, or inconsistencies before they flow into reporting.

Bank & Credit Card Reconciliation

• Reconcile assigned bank and credit card accounts against statements and verify that transactions and ending balances agree.

• Investigate discrepancies when balances or transactions do not match, including checking transaction coding and supporting documentation.

• Correct discrepancies and miscoded transactions when they fall within your authorized scope.

• Escalate unresolved, questionable, or potentially incorrect transactions with enough context for management to make a decision rather than simply flagging the issue.

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

• Maintain AP and AR records by keeping vendor invoices, expenses, payments, deposits, and receivables current.

• Add and maintain vendor records and keep the vendor list accurate, organized, and current.

• Reconcile rental income and other expected payments against applicable records or reports.

• Identify late, missing, or inconsistent payments and report them for management review.

• Review AP/AR records for missing documentation or transactions that could prevent accurate financial reporting.

Financial Documentation & Recordkeeping

• Monitor designated email accounts for incoming invoices, receipts, statements, and other bookkeeping documents.

• Identify which QuickBooks transaction each supporting document belongs to and organize the documentation in the designated cloud storage.

• Match supporting documents to applicable QuickBooks transactions so records can be located during review or tax preparation.

• Maintain complete, organized financial records that are usable for bookkeeping and tax support.

Financial Spreadsheets & Reporting

• Maintain Google Sheets and financial trackers and keep them aligned with QuickBooks records.

• Update cash flow, deal-related, and other bookkeeping spreadsheets as required.

• Compare spreadsheet information against QuickBooks and investigate inconsistencies instead of allowing conflicting records to remain.

• Assist with weekly and month-end Profit & Loss reporting and other financial reports by ensuring the underlying bookkeeping records are complete and accurate.

Month-End Bookkeeping

• Complete required transaction entries, reconciliations, AP/AR updates, and documentation before the month-end review.

title: Program Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:

In this role, you will serve as the quarterback for our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), driving the disciplined execution and operational excellence required to meet Aledade ’s strategic priorities.

As a strategic operator and internal consultant, you will partner with leaders across the organization to turn high-level vision into actionable outcomes. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between strategy and execution-fostering cross-functional collaboration, proactively addressing roadblocks, and ensuring our teams remain aligned with our most ambitious goals.

This is a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to senior leadership while developing your operational toolkit. By ensuring our business objectives are translated into successful results, you will contribute directly to Aledade ’s mission of empowering independent primary care.

Primary Duties:
Performance Management:

•
Drive Accountability: Own the end-to-end performance management of AOP Objectives and Key Results, ensuring owners are empowered and accountable for delivering on their targets.

•
Maintain Operational Tempo: Act as the heartbeat of the AOP, ensuring consistent progress through proactive follow-ups, closing feedback loops, and keeping cross-functional workstreams on schedule.

•
Surface & Mitigate Risk: Early-identify systemic risks or operational blockers to OKR success; partner with teams to develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical issues to leadership to ensure a path forward.

Strategic & Annual Planning:

•
Lead Planning Cycles: Facilitate the departmental annual planning process and mid-year (2H) adjustments, ensuring departmental goals remain ambitious yet realistic.

•
Continue to Build the Playbook: Continuously refine and document the AOP Playbook at Aledade , codifying best practices to make each planning cycle more efficient and predictable than the last.

•
QBR Preparation: Partner with department Ops Leads to prepare high-quality materials and narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring a data-driven story of progress and challenges.

Cross-Functional Orchestration & Alignment:

•
Stakeholder Management: Build deep, trust-based relationships across the organization to facilitate honest discussions regarding progress, resource gaps, and cross-departmental dependencies.

•
Early Alignment Integration: Act as the "glue" between departments, ensuring that initiatives have early and consistent alignment with Analytics, Field, and Product stakeholders.

•
Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the central point of contact to ensure that changes in one department’s roadmap are communicated and reconciled with the broader AOP.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 5+ years progressive experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

Ability to think critically, identify issues, and develop actionable strategic solutions.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders.

• Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.

• Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting

title: Head of Business Development - Logos
description:
Logos is a movement supporting the development of the decentralised web. Logos technologies lay the foundations for a freer internet upon which communities can evolve into network states. Each protocol in the Logos stack seeks to empower its users while upholding civil liberties and fundamental freedoms.

About Logos :
Logos is building the technology and community required for a more sovereign, decentralised world.
Our technology stack spans decentralised infrastructure, communications and storage, with a focus on privacy, censorship resistance and permissionless systems. We work at the intersection of protocol development, Web3 infrastructure and ecosystem building.
We’re looking for a Head of Business Development to own and drive business development across Logos , while leading a team of two.
This isn't a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who is deeply embedded in the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem, with a strong understanding of how decentralised networks operate and experience working with/launching privacy-focused protocols. Crucially, you'll have been through a mainnet launch and understand what it takes to build the partnerships, ecosystem and infrastructure relationships required both in the lead-up to launch and as the network scales post-mainnet.
The role:
As Head of Business Development, you will lead the development and execution of strategies to grow the Logos ecosystem. You will be responsible for establishing strategic partnerships, designing and executing growth strategies and building any relevant commercial relationships.
You'll identify where Logos technology can solve real problems, build relationships with protocols and infrastructure providers, and work closely with our technical teams to turn opportunities into integrations and long-term partnerships.
You'll also manage and develop a team of two, providing direction and prioritisation while remaining highly hands-on yourself.
A core part of the role is being able to operate credibly with technical stakeholders. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should understand the technology stack well enough to have substantive conversations with protocol teams, founders and engineering leaders without relying on someone else to translate the technology for you.
Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute Logos ’ BD and partnership strategy, building strategic relationships ahead of mainnet and driving ecosystem growth and adoption through expanded distribution channels post-launch.

• Identify the ecosystems, protocols, infrastructure providers and applications where Logos technology can deliver the greatest value and bring users and volume to Logos network

• Build a focused pipeline of high-value opportunities rather than pursuing partnerships for their own sake.

• Establish clear priorities and success metrics for BD activity, owning the performance of BD goals against budget.

• Own opportunities from initial identification through technical evaluation, negotiation, integration and ongoing relationship management.

Build technically meaningful partnerships:

• Develop relationships across the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem, including wallets, centralised exchanges, on/off-ramps, oracles, indexers, DeFi protocols and aggregators, multisigs and other infrastructure providers, with a particular focus on those actively engaged in the privacy ecosystem.

• Identify opportunities for integrations, deployments, ecosystem partnerships and adoption of Logos technology.

• Understand prospective partners’ technical architecture and identify how Logos can complement their technology stack through its privacy capabilities, while attracting privacy-focused applications and protocols to build on the Logos ecosystem.

• Work with technical teams on both sides to move opportunities from conversation to implementation.

• Represent Logos credibly with founders, protocol leads, ecosystem teams and technical decision-makers.

Snowflake Support is committed to providing high-quality resolutions to help deliver data-driven business insights and results. You will play an integral role in building knowledge within the team and participate in initiatives for organizational and process improvements.

Ideally, you have worked in a 24x7 environment, handled technical case escalations and incident management, worked in technical support, been on-call during weekends, and are familiar with database release management.

- Drive technical solutions to complex problems, providing in-depth analysis and guidance to Snowflake customers and partners via email, web, and phone

- 2+ years of experience in technical support or a similar technical, customer-facing function

- Ability to work in a highly collaborative environment across global teams

- Hands-on experience with at least one major RDBMS

- Strong SQL skills, including data types, aggregations, and analytical/window functions

- Experience querying and transforming semi-structured data formats such as JSON and XML

Since 2018, Button has been building reliable technology for government and private-sector clients with the goal of creating a more sustainable future through digital transformation. We create secure, easy-to-use systems through deliberate consideration and iteration. We are passionate about creating stronger communities through technology and continuing to grow across Canada and beyond.
Button Inc. was born out of a desire to take complex tasks and ideas and deliver them in a genuine, innovative, and impactful way. We help clients tackle hard problems and delight them with user-focused design and exceptional technical delivery. We start every engagement by making sure we’re solving the right problem with the most appropriate technical solution to meet our client’s needs.
About The Opportunity
Button is looking to support a government client undertaking a long-term digital modernization program to replace disconnected legacy regulatory systems and reduce technical debt. Rather than rebuilding existing applications one-for-one, the organization is creating secure, interconnected and sustainable solutions within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, supported by a common data framework. The project will deliver scalable solutions that improve business processes, data access and reporting while creating reusable components, supporting production releases, and providing the documentation and knowledge transfer needed for long-term internal support.
We're looking for a Sr Microsoft developer with a minimum of 10 years experience in the ecosystem. You will lead the full solution lifecycle using an outcome-first approach. This includes defining the business problem and user needs; assessing data ownership, integrity, migration and integration requirements; mapping those needs to Microsoft 365 capabilities; and comparing potential solutions based on simplicity, sustainability, cost and governance.
You will recommend an appropriate technology pattern with clear rationale and risk considerations, then design, test and implement the agreed solution using reusable and scalable components wherever possible. You will also prepare detailed documentation and provide hands-on knowledge transfer to support the solution’s long-term success.
You work with business and technical teams to understand and recommend the most appropriate combination of Microsoft technologies to automate business processes, improve data access and reporting, and support the modernization of the organization’s regulatory capabilities. Technologies include Teams, SharePoint, Planner, Power Platform, Dataverse, Power BI, Viva and Copilot.

• Developing Microsoft SharePoint solutions using the Microsoft Graph API, including Drive, List and Site functionality

• Managing Microsoft Teams using the Microsoft Graph API

• Developing Power Automate cloud flows using standard and custom Microsoft connectors for both automation and orchestration

• Integrating solutions with Microsoft Azure Active Directory single sign-on

• Creating Microsoft Teams Canvas Power Apps for enterprise business requirements and developing custom components using the Power Apps Componen

- пропозиція вдосконалення процесів роботи регіону
